title: Using Leverage
coreMove: Aim force at the pivot point instead of distributing effort evenly.
sourcePressure: This chapter turns discovered power into aimed force: focus effort at the pivot point where a small, concentrated action changes more than broad activity can. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Leverage means working harder, being efficient everywhere, or finding a shortcut.
